_comment: GPU-hour rates used for cost attribution. Config, not telemetry — it lives in the repo so a price change is a reviewable commit, the same rule the SLO and notification files follow. Rates are matched by substring against the DCGM modelName, longest match wins, so 'H100-SXM5' beats 'H100'.
note: Approximate on-demand list prices. Replace with your committed-use or reserved rates — an attribution built on list price overstates what you actually pay.
